# vvm_vm_brs_enrollment (Resource)

Enrolls (or unenrols) a VVM VM in IBM Cloud Backup & Recovery (BRS). Create blocks until the VM reaches `enrolled` BRS state (or until a terminal error). Delete unenrols the VM and blocks until the BRS state is no longer `enrolled`. All operations are mediated through the VVM REST API per ADR-0024; the TF resource never calls BRS directly.

The VM must be in `Running` state before enrollment (guest agent must be reachable).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) UUID of the VVM VM to enrol in BRS. Changing this value destroys the enrollment on the old VM and creates one on the new VM.

### Read-Only

- `brs_state` (String) Current BRS state of the VM: one of `enrolled`, `not_enrolled`, `unenrolled`, `install_failed`, `unknown`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier — same as `vm_id`.
- `observed_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last BRS state observation.
